IPT.evidence_source: [/page/2/Text/11] Participants were informed that they would complete one of two computer programs: one with practical strategies that can "teach them ways to deal with depression" or a comparison programme where the emphasis was on "healthy living and having fun which may also decrease depression".

dxgive.evidence_source: [/page/2/Text/11] School counsellors screened adolescents to determine the eligibility for the study. Participants were informed that they would complete one of two computer programs: one with practical strategies that can "teach them ways to deal with depression" or a comparison programme where the emphasis was on "healthy living and having fun which may also decrease depression".

Source.evidence_source: [/page/3/Text/3] The program has built-in mood monitoring questions including risk of self-harm questions, which, if endorsed, resulted in a prompt on the computer suggesting that the young person see their counsellor for more help.
